# The Compose intrinsics android declares are ordinary components, so a
# program can call one directly to reach a composable no stdlib wrapper
# covers. The generic emitter reads the declaration: the #[intrinsic] id is
# the composable's name, each declared prop is the Compose argument of that
# name in declaration order, and children are a trailing lambda.

sngl generate --platform=android --lang=kotlin --out=out app.sngl

# `chain` appends Modifier calls the Style has no field for.
grep 'Column\(modifier = Modifier\.fillMaxSize\(\)\) \{' out/MainScreen.kt

# Row's declared props, and a #id carried onto the intrinsic as a testTag.
grep 'Row\(modifier = Modifier\.testTag\("bar"\)\.padding\(4\.dp\)\) \{' out/MainScreen.kt

# A childless intrinsic takes no lambda.
grep 'Spacer\(modifier = Modifier\.height\(8\.dp\)\)' out/MainScreen.kt

# Text declares `modifier` and `style` separately, so the Style behind the
# Modifier and the one behind the TextStyle are distinct props.
grep 'Text\(text = "hi", modifier = Modifier\.padding\(1\.dp\), style = TextStyle\(fontSize = 20\.sp\)\)' out/MainScreen.kt

# The stdlib wrappers reach the same emitter: hbox's android override is
# written in terms of Row, and scroll's adds a chain entry. Both inline to
# the intrinsic, so neither name survives into codegen.
grep 'Row\(modifier = Modifier\.padding\(2\.dp\)\) \{' out/MainScreen.kt
grep 'Column\(modifier = Modifier\.verticalScroll\(rememberScrollState\(\)\)\) \{' out/MainScreen.kt

# stack layers its children, so it is a Box and not a Column.
grep 'Box\(modifier = Modifier\.padding\(3\.dp\)\) \{' out/MainScreen.kt

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:std"
import android "sngl:platforms/android"

component main {
    android.Column(chain=["fillMaxSize()"]) {
        android.Row(modifier={padding=4}) #bar {
            android.Spacer(modifier={height=8})
            android.Text(text="hi", modifier={padding=1}, style={fontSize=20})
        }
        hbox(style={padding=2}) {
            text(value="wrapped")
        }
        scroll {
            text(value="scrolled")
        }
        stack(style={padding=3}) {
            text(value="layered")
        }
    }
}
